EditTextPreference.title: Read-only API Key
EditTextPreference.dialogMessage: Create an API key in Bitget API Management. Do not enable trading, transfers or withdrawals.

EditTextPreference.dialogMessage: The secret is shown once. Keep it private.

EditTextPreference.title: API passphrase
EditTextPreference.dialogMessage: This is the passphrase chosen while creating the Bitget API key, not your Bitget password.

EditTextPreference.title: Load operations from
EditTextPreference.dialogMessage: Imports completed external stablecoin deposits and withdrawals using stable Bitget IDs.
